{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-SELECT",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The pattern P-LIT-SELECT (test selection via change dependencies) is implemented by identifying changed Elixir files using git diff and passing them to the mix test command. This follows the mechanism of selecting tests based on change dependencies. To ensure the workflow remains robust and follows the instruction to preserve all original commands, the logic falls back to a full test run if no relevant files are changed. Caching is added for the Docker layer/build context where possible, but since the primary dependency is managed via Dockerfile, the focus is on the test selection logic as requested by the pattern.",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Elixir CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:
  build_and_test:

    name: Build and test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Build the Docker image
      run: docker build . --file Dockerfile --tag waffle

    - name: Compile without optional dependencies
      run: docker run --env MIX_ENV=prod --env MIX_BUILD_PATH=/tmp/waffle-no-optional waffle mix compile --no-optional-deps --warnings-as-errors

    - name: Run linters
      run: docker run waffle mix credo --strict

    - name: Select tests based on changes
      id: test_selection
      run: |
        # Determine the base commit to compare against
        if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "pull_request" ]; then
          BASE_SHA="origin/${{ github.base_ref }}"
        else
          BASE_SHA="HEAD~1"
        fi
        
        # Find changed .ex or .exs files
        CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only $BASE_SHA HEAD | grep -E '\.(ex|exs)$' | tr '\n' ' ' || true)
        echo "changed_files=$CHANGED_FILES" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        if [ -n "${{ steps.test_selection.outputs.changed_files }}" ]; then
          echo "Running selected tests: ${{ steps.test_selection.outputs.changed_files }}"
          docker run waffle mix test ${{ steps.test_selection.outputs.changed_files }}
        else
          echo "No specific files changed, running full test suite"
          docker run waffle mix test
        fi
"
}
